title: Set the restore button to form reset
goal: Select the button type and use native reset to restore the control's initial value.
summary: The tab editor needs to provide both saving and restoring. When restored, the input box should return to the name written in the value attribute.
tasks: Set the correct type to #restore so that it can restore the form's initial value.
retains the commit behavior of #send. Try entering another name and pressing the restore button.

example.note: A button without type in the form will try to submit by default. Indicate the type of button for each purpose.

hint: reset button will restore the default value. When the default value is not empty, there will still be text after restoration.
